narration.full_text: Namaste students! Today, we're diving into the fascinating world of plant coordination. While animals have complex nervous systems, plants also exhibit incredible ways to respond to their environment and regulate their growth. We'll explore how plants perceive stimuli and coordinate their actions through various mechanisms. Let's begin our journey into understanding plant intelligence! Our focus will be on understanding the different types of tropic movements in plants, identifying the key plant hormones and their specific functions, and finally, comprehending how plants respond to crucial environmental stimuli such as light, gravity, and water. These responses are vital for their survival and growth.
